specs.title: Login with a valid and an invalid password

steps.title: Precondition: create a customer who is not logged in
1. Open the login page
2. Log in with the email and the wrong password
3. Open the account menu
4. Close the menu and log in with the correct password
5. Open the account menu

specs.title: Add a product to the basket

steps.title: 1. Open the product list
2. Click "Add to Basket" on the product
3. Open the basket with the button "Your Basket"
4. Read the total of the basket

steps.title: Precondition: log in a new customer with a saved address, a saved card and the product in the basket
1. Open the basket and click "Checkout"
2. Select the saved address and continue
3. Select "One Day Delivery" and continue
4. Redeem the coupon of the current month
5. Select the saved card and continue
Precondition: log in a new customer with a saved address, a saved card, the product in the basket and 5.00 in the wallet
1. Open the basket, click "Checkout", select the saved address and continue
2. Select "Standard Delivery" and continue
3. Read the button "Pay 8.99¤"
4. Open "Order History" from the account menu
5. Open "Digital Wallet" from the account menu
Precondition: add 3.99 to the wallet with the saved card
6. Go through checkout to the payment step with "Standard Delivery"
7. Click "Pay 8.99¤"
8. Click "Place your order and pay"
9. Open "Digital Wallet" from the account menu
10. Open "Order History" from the account menu
